caseName: Grace Corso v. Security-First National Bank of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: Corso v. Security-First National Bank of Los Angeles, Executor
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Henry F. Walker for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
